required_check: Scan schema documents and manifest text for authorization language around executable triggers, strategy behavior, live/default-on/tiny-live, deployment, or promotion.
reject_if: The artifact grants or implies executable authorization instead of prohibition or boundary language.
notes: Design-only requirement; no validator code is implemented in T005.

required_check: Require lineage references to accepted local public artifacts only.
reject_if: The schema references private/account/order endpoints, new collection, or remote execution as an allowed action.
notes: Lineage may cite T002 paths only as historical provenance.

required_check: Require zero row-level case entries, zero case catalog rows, and no per-row case output files in T005.
reject_if: Any artifact contains generated row-level case entries or a case catalog.
notes: Future row-level read-only artifacts require a separate task and QA.

required_check: Forbid fields named or typed as order side, quote price, quote size, leverage, stop, take-profit, submit, cancel, fill, or live action outputs.
reject_if: The schema defines action-capable trading fields.
notes: Execution fields cannot be introduced by a schema-design task.

required_check: Require decision-time visible context fields to be marked read-only context or rationale only.
reject_if: Any decision-time context field is marked as a trigger, order condition, live rule, or shadow decision input.
notes: Context fields may support later read-only discussion only.

required_check: Require diagnostic fields to remain diagnostic or gate-summary only.
reject_if: A diagnostic field is promoted to production gate, parameter, quote-control, or live behavior.
notes: Diagnostic context cannot become strategy behavior in T005.

required_check: Require all labels to remain read_only_design_label or read-only context labels.
reject_if: A label is usable as a case-library trigger, shadow decision, order side, or trading instruction.

required_check: Require future labels to appear only in output or evidence sections and never in input, condition, trigger, or shadow-decision sections.
reject_if: A future label is referenced as an input feature, filter condition, trigger, case condition, or live decision field.
notes: This guards against offline label leakage.

required_check: Require validator content in T005 to be requirements or design-only pseudocode at most.
reject_if: Executable validator code or enforcement implementation is added in T005.
notes: A later task may implement validators only if separately dispatched.

required_check: Require the acceptance gate to say that later row-level artifacts need a separate task and QA before generation.
reject_if: The gate implies that passing T005 authorizes row-level artifact generation.
notes: T005 readiness is schema readiness only.

required_check: Require reject conditions to preserve T004 boundaries without weakening them.
reject_if: Any reject condition removes or weakens T004 forbidden behavior boundaries.
notes: T005 may tighten but not relax T004.

required_check: Require every execution-layer item to remain unproven unless a separate QA-accepted evidence task is cited.
reject_if: The schema claims fill probability, queue, post-only, cancel-fill, fees, inventory, or real order lifecycle is proven.
notes: Current evidence is public observation-layer only.

required_check: Reject any component that supports strategy implementation, private/order endpoint behavior, live/default-on/tiny-live, parameter search, deployment recommendation, or promotion.
reject_if: A forbidden component is marked allowed or required.
notes: This is a hard schema-level rejection.
